prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Make a NEW animation parts atlas in the exact simple flat graphic art style of the attached reference. TRANSPARENT background. Strict flat opaque solid colors, no lighting, NO SHADOWS, no gradients, no highlights, no texture, no outlines. Each shape is a constant single color, like colored paper cutouts. Friendly young woman Mina: dark brown wavy bob, medium ochre skin, magenta open cardigan over cream shirt, navy trousers and orange low trainers. Simple oval eyes and friendly open smile. Artwork must be simpler and flatter than a painted children's illustration. Palette only: hair #38272B, skin #D98645, cardigan #B8175A, cream #FFECCB, navy #23364D, orange #F68B1F, white #FFFFFF, mouth #752F32. Sprite production asset, not a full character picture: TWELVE disconnected separate body pieces arranged in a very regular 4-column x3-row grid with generous transparent gaps. Every piece straight vertical unless specified. Canvas wide4:3. Row1: complete head including neck; sleeveless torso/cardigan with no arms and no exposed skin around neck; left upper sleeve capsule; left forearm sleeve ending in a small palm/open hand. Row2: right upper sleeve capsule; right forearm sleeve ending in palm/open hand; left upper navy trouser capsule; left lower navy trouser leg ending in left-facing orange shoe. Row3: right upper navy trouser capsule; right lower navy trouser leg ending in right-facing orange shoe; simple orange backpack; unfolded cream map with geometric flat green park patches and blue river, no writing. Equal cell widths. Keep every part wholly within its own cell. Sleeves are uniform magenta with no wrinkles and no shadows. Skin including hands/neck/face is uniform ochre with no shadows. No connecting lines, no labels, no ground/floor/ellipses, no tiny texture lines. Anatomically usable rounded joint caps hidden inside seams. Transparent alpha between every part.
